title: London Parade organizer —1 January 2027 route and viewing

facts.fact: The organizer dates the parade Friday 1 January 2027 and lists Piccadilly,Regent Street,St James’s,Pall Mall,Trafalgar Square and Whitehall.
General public standing is free, while ticket holders have separate arrival instructions; the published parade timing is 1pm–4:30pm.
